_comment: Shared by the backend PNG renderer (services/raster.py) and the frontend WebGL LUT (lib/color/colormaps.ts). One definition, so a tile and a volume of the same variable are never coloured differently. Stops are [position, r, g, b] with position in 0..1 and channels in 0..255. Palettes approximate the cmocean family, which is the de facto standard in oceanography and is perceptually uniform.

delta.label: Delta
delta.description: Diverging, for velocities and anomalies. Zero maps to the pale midpoint.

algae.label: Algae
algae.description: Sequential, for chlorophyll. Usually paired with a log scale.

gray.label: Greyscale
gray.description: Neutral fallback, and used for bathymetry shading.
